text:
Casey hosted 4 licensed child care providers in 2025
According to the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services, there were 4 licensed child care facilities in Casey in 2025.
Half of these were day care centers and the other half were group day care homes.
The licensed child care providers in Casey serve children from birth to age 12, as well as those aged 3 to 5 years.
All facilities in Casey offer services in English as the primary language.
Across Illinois, there were 8,602 licensed child care facilities reported in 2025.
The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has frozen federal child care and family assistance funding for Illinois, California, Colorado, Minnesota and New York amid concerns of fraud and misuse, the agency announced Jan. 6. The measure suspends nearly $2.4 billion in Child Care and Development Fund grants, $7.35 billion in Temporary Assistance for Needy Families funds, and $869 million in Social Services Block Grants, and requires additional state documentation before payments resume.
Gov. J.B. Pritzker of Illinois called the decision “wrong and cruel” and indicated the state may contest the freeze, highlighting that current anti-fraud protocols exist in Illinois.
The freeze, according to state officials, could impact about 100,000 families and more than 152,000 children receiving support via the Child Care Assistance Program, as well as thousands of licensed child care providers and 275 human service organizations in Illinois.
